steps.en: Check the kernel is 5.17+ with BPF/BTF options, then install the dae package
steps.zh: 确认内核 ≥5.17 且开了 BPF／BTF 选项，再装 dae 包
steps.code: sudo apt install dae · sudo pacman -S dae

steps.en: Write your interfaces, subscription, node group and routing rules into one config file
steps.zh: 把网卡、订阅、节点组和分流规则写进一个配置文件

steps.en: Loads an eBPF program at the tc hook of the bound LAN/WAN interfaces and pulls your subscription
steps.zh: 在绑定的 LAN／WAN 网卡 tc 钩子上加载 eBPF 程序，并拉取订阅

steps.en: Matches each new flow in-kernel by IP, port, MAC, process name or DNS-learned domain
steps.zh: 在内核里按 IP、端口、MAC、进程名或 DNS 得到的域名匹配每条新连接

steps.en: Forwards direct flows in the kernel; hands proxied flows to the lowest-latency node in the group
steps.zh: 直连流量由内核直接转发，代理流量交给组里延迟最低的节点

value.en: The whole LAN and host are split-routed without per-app proxy settings, and direct traffic never pays a userspace proxy hop
value.zh: 整个局域网和本机都按规则分流，无需逐个应用设代理，直连流量不再绕经用户态代理进程
